"""Bayesian 2PL+gamma IRT fitting for contamination calibration.

Model: P(x_ij = 1) = sigma(a_i * (theta_j - b_i) + gamma_i * e_j)
Convention: gamma > 0 = contamination makes item easier.
"""

import argparse
import sys
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)


def load_data(data_dir, benchmark):
    data_dir = Path(data_dir)
    resp_path = data_dir / f"response_matrix_{benchmark}.csv"
    if not resp_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: {resp_path} not found")

    resp_df = pd.read_csv(resp_path)
    respondent_ids = resp_df["respondent"].values
    item_cols = [c for c in resp_df.columns if c != "respondent"]
    X = resp_df[item_cols].values.astype(np.float64)

    exp_path = data_dir / "exposure_scores.csv"
    if not exp_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: {exp_path} not found")
    exp_df = pd.read_csv(exp_path)
    exp_map = dict(zip(exp_df["respondent"], exp_df["exposure"]))
    exposure = np.array([exp_map[r] for r in respondent_ids])

    return X, respondent_ids, item_cols, exposure


def fit_2pl_gamma(X, exposure, method="advi", draws=1000, max_items=None, random_seed=42):
    import pymc as pm

    J, I_total = X.shape
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_seed)

    if max_items and max_items < I_total:
        idx = np.sort(rng.choice(I_total, max_items, replace=False))
        X = X[:, idx]
        I = max_items
    else:
        idx = None
        I = I_total

    print(f"Fitting 2PL+γ: {J} respondents × {I} items, method={method}")

    with pm.Model() as model:
        theta = pm.Normal("theta", mu=0, sigma=1, shape=J)
        log_a = pm.Normal("log_a", mu=0, sigma=0.5, shape=I)
        a = pm.Deterministic("a", pm.math.exp(log_a))
        b = pm.Normal("b", mu=0, sigma=2, shape=I)
        gamma = pm.Normal("gamma", mu=0, sigma=1, shape=I)

        logit_p = a[None, :] * (theta[:, None] - b[None, :]) + gamma[None, :] * exposure[:, None]
        pm.Bernoulli("obs", logit_p=logit_p, observed=X)

        if method == "advi":
            approx = pm.fit(n=20000, method="advi", random_seed=random_seed,
                            progressbar=True)
            trace = approx.sample(draws)
        elif method == "nuts":
            trace = pm.sample(draws=draws, tune=1000, cores=1,
                              random_seed=random_seed, progressbar=True)
        else:
            sys.exit(f"Unknown method: {method}")

    return trace, model, idx


def summarize_results(trace, respondent_ids, item_cols, exposure, idx=None):
    theta_post = trace.posterior["theta"].values
    theta_mean = theta_post.mean(axis=(0, 1))
    theta_sd = theta_post.std(axis=(0, 1))

    gamma_post = trace.posterior["gamma"].values
    gamma_mean = gamma_post.mean(axis=(0, 1))
    gamma_sd = gamma_post.std(axis=(0, 1))

    a_post = trace.posterior["a"].values
    b_post = trace.posterior["b"].values
    a_mean = a_post.mean(axis=(0, 1))
    b_mean = b_post.mean(axis=(0, 1))

    print(f"\n--- Theta (ability) ---")
    for j, rid in enumerate(respondent_ids):
        print(f"  {rid}: θ={theta_mean[j]:.3f} ± {theta_sd[j]:.3f}  (exposure={exposure[j]:.2f})")

    actual_cols = [item_cols[i] for i in idx] if idx is not None else item_cols
    n_show = min(10, len(gamma_mean))
    print(f"\n--- Item params (first {n_show} of {len(gamma_mean)} items) ---")
    for i in range(n_show):
        print(f"  {actual_cols[i]}: a={a_mean[i]:.3f}, b={b_mean[i]:.3f}, γ={gamma_mean[i]:.3f} ± {gamma_sd[i]:.3f}")

    print(f"\n--- Gamma (contamination effect) summary ---")
    print(f"  mean(γ) = {gamma_mean.mean():.4f} ± {gamma_mean.std():.4f}")
    print(f"  median(γ) = {np.median(gamma_mean):.4f}")
    pct_pos = (gamma_mean > 0).mean() * 100
    print(f"  % items with γ > 0: {pct_pos:.1f}%")

    return dict(theta_mean=theta_mean, theta_sd=theta_sd,
                a_mean=a_mean, b_mean=b_mean,
                gamma_mean=gamma_mean, gamma_sd=gamma_sd)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fit 2PL+γ IRT model")
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", required=True, choices=["mmlu", "arc"])
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--max-items", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--method", default="advi", choices=["advi", "nuts"])
    parser.add_argument("--draws", type=int, default=1000)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.data_dir is None:
        args.data_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "irt_data_v3"

    X, respondent_ids, item_cols, exposure = load_data(args.data_dir, args.benchmark)
    n_respondents, n_items = X.shape

    print(f"Loaded {n_respondents} respondents × {n_items} items")
    if n_respondents < 25:
        print(f"WARNING: only {n_respondents} respondents (expected ≥ 25)")

    trace, model, idx = fit_2pl_gamma(
        X, exposure, method=args.method, draws=args.draws,
        max_items=args.max_items, random_seed=args.seed)

    results = summarize_results(trace, respondent_ids, item_cols, exposure, idx)

    if args.output_dir:
        import arviz as az
        out = Path(args.output_dir)
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        trace.to_netcdf(str(out / f"trace_{args.benchmark}.nc"))
        print(f"\nTrace saved: {out / f'trace_{args.benchmark}.nc'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Threshold DGP simulation: demonstrate attenuation when linear 2PL+γ
is fit to data generated from a step-function contamination mechanism.

R3-W10: reviewer-requested experiment for Round 6.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def generate_data(N, J, gamma_true, dgp_type, seed):
    """Generate binary response matrix under linear or threshold DGP.

    Parameters
    ----------
    N : int – number of respondents (LLMs)
    J : int – number of items
    gamma_true : float – true contamination effect size
    dgp_type : str – "linear" or "threshold"
    seed : int – random seed

    Returns
    -------
    y : ndarray (N, J) – binary response matrix
    exposure_matrix : ndarray (N, J) – exposure values (broadcast)
    true_params : dict
    """
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)

    theta = rng.randn(N)
    a = np.exp(rng.randn(J) * 0.5)  # lognormal(0, 0.5) matching Stan prior
    b = rng.randn(J)
    exposure = rng.uniform(0, 1, size=N)

    # Broadcast exposure to (N, J) matrix
    exposure_matrix = np.tile(exposure[:, None], (1, J))

    # Compute contamination effect
    if dgp_type == "linear":
        gamma_effect = gamma_true * exposure_matrix
    elif dgp_type == "threshold":
        med = np.median(exposure)
        gamma_effect = np.where(exposure_matrix > med, gamma_true, 0.0)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown dgp_type: {dgp_type}")

    # IRT logit
    eta = a[None, :] * (theta[:, None] - b[None, :]) + gamma_effect
    prob = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-eta))
    y = (rng.uniform(size=(N, J)) < prob).astype(int)

    true_params = dict(
        theta=theta, a=a, b=b, gamma_true=gamma_true,
        exposure=exposure, dgp_type=dgp_type,
    )
    return y, exposure_matrix, true_params


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stan fitting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def fit_stan_model(y, exposure_matrix, stan_file, seed=1, chains=4,
                   iter_sampling=1000, iter_warmup=500):
    """Fit the linear 2PL+γ Stan model via CmdStanPy.

    Returns dict with gamma posterior summary and diagnostics.
    """
    import cmdstanpy

    N, J = y.shape
    stan_data = dict(
        N_models=N,
        N_items=J,
        y=y.tolist(),
        exposure=exposure_matrix.tolist(),
    )

    model = cmdstanpy.CmdStanModel(stan_file=str(stan_file))

    fit = model.sample(
        data=stan_data,
        seed=seed,
        chains=chains,
        iter_sampling=iter_sampling,
        iter_warmup=iter_warmup,
        show_progress=False,
        show_console=False,
    )

    # Extract gamma
    gamma_draws = fit.stan_variable("gamma")  # shape (chains*iter_sampling,)
    gamma_mean = float(np.mean(gamma_draws))
    gamma_sd = float(np.std(gamma_draws))
    gamma_q025 = float(np.percentile(gamma_draws, 2.5))
    gamma_q975 = float(np.percentile(gamma_draws, 97.5))

    # Diagnostics
    diag = fit.diagnose()
    n_divergent = diag.count("divergent transition") if isinstance(diag, str) else 0

    return dict(
        gamma_mean=gamma_mean,
        gamma_sd=gamma_sd,
        gamma_q025=gamma_q025,
        gamma_q975=gamma_q975,
        n_divergent=n_divergent,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Single run
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_single(N, J, gamma_true, dgp_type, seed, stan_file, chains=4,
               iter_sampling=1000, iter_warmup=500):
    """Run one simulation: generate + fit + summarize."""
    y, exposure_matrix, true_params = generate_data(N, J, gamma_true, dgp_type, seed)

    result = fit_stan_model(
        y, exposure_matrix, stan_file, seed=seed,
        chains=chains, iter_sampling=iter_sampling, iter_warmup=iter_warmup,
    )

    gamma_hat = result["gamma_mean"]
    covers = (result["gamma_q025"] <= gamma_true <= result["gamma_q975"])
    attenuation = gamma_hat / gamma_true if gamma_true != 0 else np.nan

    return dict(
        dgp_type=dgp_type,
        N=N,
        J=J,
        gamma_true=gamma_true,
        seed=seed,
        gamma_hat=gamma_hat,
        gamma_hat_sd=result["gamma_sd"],
        gamma_q025=result["gamma_q025"],
        gamma_q975=result["gamma_q975"],
        covers_95ci=int(covers),
        attenuation_ratio=attenuation,
        n_divergent=result["n_divergent"],
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main sweep
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--stan-file", type=str, default=None,
                        help="Path to contam_irt_2pl_gamma.stan")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str,
                        default="/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/artifacts/threshold_dgp")
    parser.add_argument("--N", type=int, default=20,
                        help="Number of respondents")
    parser.add_argument("--n-seeds", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--chains", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--iter-sampling", type=int, default=1000)
    parser.add_argument("--iter-warmup", type=int, default=500)
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                        help="Run 1 condition x 1 seed only")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.stan_file is None:
        args.stan_file = "/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/stan_models/contam_irt_2pl_gamma.stan"

    stan_file = Path(args.stan_file)
    if not stan_file.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Stan file not found: {stan_file}")

    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # Parameter grid: 4 J levels x 5 gamma levels = 20 conditions
    J_values = [50, 100, 200, 500]
    gamma_values = [0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0]

    if args.dry_run:
        J_values = [100]
        gamma_values = [1.0]
        seeds = [0]
        print("=== DRY RUN: 1 condition (J=100, γ=1.0) × 1 seed ===")
    else:
        seeds = list(range(args.n_seeds))

    # We run BOTH dgp types for every condition to show the contrast
    dgp_types = ["linear", "threshold"]

    total = len(dgp_types) * len(J_values) * len(gamma_values) * len(seeds)
    print(f"Total runs: {total} ({len(dgp_types)} DGPs × {len(J_values)} J × "
          f"{len(gamma_values)} γ × {len(seeds)} seeds)")
    print(f"N_respondents = {args.N}, chains = {args.chains}, "
          f"iter = {args.iter_sampling}+{args.iter_warmup}")

    results = []
    done = 0
    t0 = time.time()

    for dgp_type in dgp_types:
        for J in J_values:
            for gamma_true in gamma_values:
                for seed in seeds:
                    done += 1
                    label = f"[{done}/{total}] dgp={dgp_type} J={J} γ={gamma_true} seed={seed}"
                    try:
                        row = run_single(
                            N=args.N, J=J, gamma_true=gamma_true,
                            dgp_type=dgp_type, seed=seed,
                            stan_file=stan_file,
                            chains=args.chains,
                            iter_sampling=args.iter_sampling,
                            iter_warmup=args.iter_warmup,
                        )
                        results.append(row)
                        elapsed = time.time() - t0
                        eta = elapsed / done * (total - done)
                        print(f"{label} → γ̂={row['gamma_hat']:.3f} "
                              f"atten={row['attenuation_ratio']:.3f} "
                              f"div={row['n_divergent']} "
                              f"[{elapsed:.0f}s elapsed, ETA {eta:.0f}s]",
                              flush=True)
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"{label} FAILED: {e}", flush=True)
                        results.append(dict(
                            dgp_type=dgp_type, N=args.N, J=J,
                            gamma_true=gamma_true, seed=seed,
                            gamma_hat=np.nan, gamma_hat_sd=np.nan,
                            gamma_q025=np.nan, gamma_q975=np.nan,
                            covers_95ci=np.nan, attenuation_ratio=np.nan,
                            n_divergent=np.nan, error=str(e),
                        ))

    # Save raw results
    df = pd.DataFrame(results)
    raw_path = output_dir / "threshold_dgp_raw.csv"
    df.to_csv(raw_path, index=False)
    print(f"\nRaw results saved: {raw_path}")

    # Summary table
    if len(df) > 0 and not df["attenuation_ratio"].isna().all():
        summary = (
            df.groupby(["dgp_type", "J", "gamma_true"])
            .agg(
                mean_attenuation=("attenuation_ratio", "mean"),
                sd_attenuation=("attenuation_ratio", "std"),
                coverage_95ci=("covers_95ci", "mean"),
                mean_gamma_hat=("gamma_hat", "mean"),
                mean_divergent=("n_divergent", "mean"),
                n_runs=("seed", "count"),
            )
            .reset_index()
        )
        summary_path = output_dir / "threshold_dgp_summary.csv"
        summary.to_csv(summary_path, index=False)
        print(f"Summary saved: {summary_path}")

        # Print summary
        print("\n" + "=" * 80)
        print("SUMMARY: Attenuation ratios (γ̂/γ_true)")
        print("=" * 80)
        for dgp in dgp_types:
            sub = summary[summary["dgp_type"] == dgp]
            print(f"\n--- DGP: {dgp} ---")
            pivot = sub.pivot_table(
                index="J", columns="gamma_true",
                values="mean_attenuation", aggfunc="first"
            )
            print(pivot.to_string(float_format="%.3f"))

        print("\n--- Coverage (95% CI) under threshold DGP ---")
        thr = summary[summary["dgp_type"] == "threshold"]
        pivot_cov = thr.pivot_table(
            index="J", columns="gamma_true",
            values="coverage_95ci", aggfunc="first"
        )
        print(pivot_cov.to_string(float_format="%.2f"))

    # Sentinel file
    with open(output_dir / "DONE", "w") as f:
        f.write(f"completed at {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")
        f.write(f"total runs: {total}, elapsed: {time.time() - t0:.0f}s\n")

    print(f"\nTotal time: {time.time() - t0:.0f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Threshold DGP simulation: demonstrate attenuation when linear 2PL+γ
is fit to data generated from a step-function contamination mechanism.

R3-W10: reviewer-requested experiment for Round 6.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def generate_data(N, J, gamma_true, dgp_type, seed):
    """Generate binary response matrix under linear or threshold DGP.

    Parameters
    ----------
    N : int – number of respondents (LLMs)
    J : int – number of items
    gamma_true : float – true contamination effect size
    dgp_type : str – "linear" or "threshold"
    seed : int – random seed

    Returns
    -------
    y : ndarray (N, J) – binary response matrix
    exposure_matrix : ndarray (N, J) – exposure values (broadcast)
    true_params : dict
    """
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)

    theta = rng.randn(N)
    a = np.exp(rng.randn(J) * 0.5)  # lognormal(0, 0.5) matching Stan prior
    b = rng.randn(J)
    exposure = rng.uniform(0, 1, size=N)

    # Broadcast exposure to (N, J) matrix
    exposure_matrix = np.tile(exposure[:, None], (1, J))

    # Compute contamination effect
    if dgp_type == "linear":
        gamma_effect = gamma_true * exposure_matrix
    elif dgp_type == "threshold":
        med = np.median(exposure)
        gamma_effect = np.where(exposure_matrix > med, gamma_true, 0.0)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown dgp_type: {dgp_type}")

    # IRT logit
    eta = a[None, :] * (theta[:, None] - b[None, :]) + gamma_effect
    prob = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-eta))
    y = (rng.uniform(size=(N, J)) < prob).astype(int)

    true_params = dict(
        theta=theta, a=a, b=b, gamma_true=gamma_true,
        exposure=exposure, dgp_type=dgp_type,
    )
    return y, exposure_matrix, true_params


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stan fitting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def fit_stan_model(y, exposure_matrix, stan_file, seed=1, chains=4,
                   iter_sampling=1000, iter_warmup=500):
    """Fit the linear 2PL+γ Stan model via CmdStanPy.

    Returns dict with gamma posterior summary and diagnostics.
    """
    import cmdstanpy

    N, J = y.shape
    stan_data = dict(
        N_models=N,
        N_items=J,
        y=y.tolist(),
        exposure=exposure_matrix.tolist(),
    )

    model = cmdstanpy.CmdStanModel(stan_file=str(stan_file))

    fit = model.sample(
        data=stan_data,
        seed=seed,
        chains=chains,
        iter_sampling=iter_sampling,
        iter_warmup=iter_warmup,
        show_progress=False,
        show_console=False,
    )

    # Extract gamma
    gamma_draws = fit.stan_variable("gamma")  # shape (chains*iter_sampling,)
    gamma_mean = float(np.mean(gamma_draws))
    gamma_sd = float(np.std(gamma_draws))
    gamma_q025 = float(np.percentile(gamma_draws, 2.5))
    gamma_q975 = float(np.percentile(gamma_draws, 97.5))

    # Diagnostics
    diag = fit.diagnose()
    n_divergent = diag.count("divergent transition") if isinstance(diag, str) else 0

    return dict(
        gamma_mean=gamma_mean,
        gamma_sd=gamma_sd,
        gamma_q025=gamma_q025,
        gamma_q975=gamma_q975,
        n_divergent=n_divergent,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Single run
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_single(N, J, gamma_true, dgp_type, seed, stan_file, chains=4,
               iter_sampling=1000, iter_warmup=500):
    """Run one simulation: generate + fit + summarize."""
    y, exposure_matrix, true_params = generate_data(N, J, gamma_true, dgp_type, seed)

    result = fit_stan_model(
        y, exposure_matrix, stan_file, seed=seed,
        chains=chains, iter_sampling=iter_sampling, iter_warmup=iter_warmup,
    )

    gamma_hat = result["gamma_mean"]
    covers = (result["gamma_q025"] <= gamma_true <= result["gamma_q975"])
    attenuation = gamma_hat / gamma_true if gamma_true != 0 else np.nan

    return dict(
        dgp_type=dgp_type,
        N=N,
        J=J,
        gamma_true=gamma_true,
        seed=seed,
        gamma_hat=gamma_hat,
        gamma_hat_sd=result["gamma_sd"],
        gamma_q025=result["gamma_q025"],
        gamma_q975=result["gamma_q975"],
        covers_95ci=int(covers),
        attenuation_ratio=attenuation,
        n_divergent=result["n_divergent"],
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main sweep
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--stan-file", type=str, default=None,
                        help="Path to contam_irt_2pl_gamma.stan")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str,
                        default="/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/artifacts/threshold_dgp")
    parser.add_argument("--N", type=int, default=20,
                        help="Number of respondents")
    parser.add_argument("--n-seeds", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--chains", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--iter-sampling", type=int, default=1000)
    parser.add_argument("--iter-warmup", type=int, default=500)
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                        help="Run 1 condition x 1 seed only")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.stan_file is None:
        args.stan_file = "/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/stan_models/contam_irt_2pl_gamma.stan"

    stan_file = Path(args.stan_file)
    if not stan_file.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Stan file not found: {stan_file}")

    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # Parameter grid: 4 J levels x 5 gamma levels = 20 conditions
    J_values = [50, 100, 200, 500]
    gamma_values = [0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0]

    if args.dry_run:
        J_values = [100]
        gamma_values = [1.0]
        seeds = [0]
        print("=== DRY RUN: 1 condition (J=100, γ=1.0) × 1 seed ===")
    else:
        seeds = list(range(args.n_seeds))

    # We run BOTH dgp types for every condition to show the contrast
    dgp_types = ["linear", "threshold"]

    total = len(dgp_types) * len(J_values) * len(gamma_values) * len(seeds)
    print(f"Total runs: {total} ({len(dgp_types)} DGPs × {len(J_values)} J × "
          f"{len(gamma_values)} γ × {len(seeds)} seeds)")
    print(f"N_respondents = {args.N}, chains = {args.chains}, "
          f"iter = {args.iter_sampling}+{args.iter_warmup}")

    results = []
    done = 0
    t0 = time.time()

    for dgp_type in dgp_types:
        for J in J_values:
            for gamma_true in gamma_values:
                for seed in seeds:
                    done += 1
                    label = f"[{done}/{total}] dgp={dgp_type} J={J} γ={gamma_true} seed={seed}"
                    try:
                        row = run_single(
                            N=args.N, J=J, gamma_true=gamma_true,
                            dgp_type=dgp_type, seed=seed,
                            stan_file=stan_file,
                            chains=args.chains,
                            iter_sampling=args.iter_sampling,
                            iter_warmup=args.iter_warmup,
                        )
                        results.append(row)
                        elapsed = time.time() - t0
                        eta = elapsed / done * (total - done)
                        print(f"{label} → γ̂={row['gamma_hat']:.3f} "
                              f"atten={row['attenuation_ratio']:.3f} "
                              f"div={row['n_divergent']} "
                              f"[{elapsed:.0f}s elapsed, ETA {eta:.0f}s]",
                              flush=True)
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"{label} FAILED: {e}", flush=True)
                        results.append(dict(
                            dgp_type=dgp_type, N=args.N, J=J,
                            gamma_true=gamma_true, seed=seed,
                            gamma_hat=np.nan, gamma_hat_sd=np.nan,
                            gamma_q025=np.nan, gamma_q975=np.nan,
                            covers_95ci=np.nan, attenuation_ratio=np.nan,
                            n_divergent=np.nan, error=str(e),
                        ))

    # Save raw results
    df = pd.DataFrame(results)
    raw_path = output_dir / "threshold_dgp_raw.csv"
    df.to_csv(raw_path, index=False)
    print(f"\nRaw results saved: {raw_path}")

    # Summary table
    if len(df) > 0 and not df["attenuation_ratio"].isna().all():
        summary = (
            df.groupby(["dgp_type", "J", "gamma_true"])
            .agg(
                mean_attenuation=("attenuation_ratio", "mean"),
                sd_attenuation=("attenuation_ratio", "std"),
                coverage_95ci=("covers_95ci", "mean"),
                mean_gamma_hat=("gamma_hat", "mean"),
                mean_divergent=("n_divergent", "mean"),
                n_runs=("seed", "count"),
            )
            .reset_index()
        )
        summary_path = output_dir / "threshold_dgp_summary.csv"
        summary.to_csv(summary_path, index=False)
        print(f"Summary saved: {summary_path}")

        # Print summary
        print("\n" + "=" * 80)
        print("SUMMARY: Attenuation ratios (γ̂/γ_true)")
        print("=" * 80)
        for dgp in dgp_types:
            sub = summary[summary["dgp_type"] == dgp]
            print(f"\n--- DGP: {dgp} ---")
            pivot = sub.pivot_table(
                index="J", columns="gamma_true",
                values="mean_attenuation", aggfunc="first"
            )
            print(pivot.to_string(float_format="%.3f"))

        print("\n--- Coverage (95% CI) under threshold DGP ---")
        thr = summary[summary["dgp_type"] == "threshold"]
        pivot_cov = thr.pivot_table(
            index="J", columns="gamma_true",
            values="coverage_95ci", aggfunc="first"
        )
        print(pivot_cov.to_string(float_format="%.2f"))

    # Sentinel file
    with open(output_dir / "DONE", "w") as f:
        f.write(f"completed at {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")
        f.write(f"total runs: {total}, elapsed: {time.time() - t0:.0f}s\n")

    print(f"\nTotal time: {time.time() - t0:.0f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
